summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of LATAM Reportero redesign. All major features functioning correctly including NYT-style editorial layout, contributor reputation system, multilingual support, community pages with Signal/WhatsApp integration, and pricing with crypto donations.

design_issues.issue: Currency toggle on pricing page has incomplete USD/MXN tab functionality - tabs exist but switching behavior may need refinement

passed_tests: ✅ NYT-style editorial homepage layout with featured article hero and sidebar
✅ Contributor reputation badges system (Verified, Editor, Longtime, Reviewed) replacing trust scores
✅ Language selector with active languages (EN/ES/PT) and indigenous languages (Quechua, Aymara) with Coming Soon dialogs
✅ Community page with 8 regional groups including Signal and WhatsApp integration
✅ Pricing page with all 4 plans (Free, Monthly, Annual, Lifetime) and subscribe buttons
✅ Crypto donation functionality with MetaMask integration for ETH, BTC, USDC, ADA
✅ Newsletter signup components on homepage (hero variant) and footer
✅ Main navigation links (Solutions, Community, Writers, Pricing) properly working
✅ Authentication links (Login/Sign Up) present in header
✅ Footer with company branding, navigation sections, and social links
✅ Backend API endpoints all working (6/6 tests passed)
✅ Responsive design and proper styling throughout

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (All major features working, minor currency toggle issue)
